Body.Content: Azure Scheduler is now available in the Australia East and Australia Southeast regions. With these supported regions, Azure Scheduler is available in every region around the world where Azure is available. For more information, visit the Scheduler page. To see all of the available regions and pricing, visit the Scheduler Pricing Details page.
Body.Markdown:
Azure Scheduler is now available in the Australia East and Australia Southeast regions. With these supported regions, Azure Scheduler is available in every region around the world where Azure is available.

For more information, visit the Scheduler page. To see all of the available regions and pricing, visit the Scheduler Pricing Details page.
